observations.title: Net migration
observations.population: All nationalities, including British nationals; long-term moves
observations.does_not_measure: Visa grants, border crossings or asylum claims.

observations.title: Long-term immigration
observations.population: All nationalities moving to the UK for at least 12 months
observations.measures: Estimated long-term moves into the UK.
observations.does_not_measure: Every passenger arrival or every visa issued.

observations.title: Long-term emigration
observations.population: All nationalities leaving the UK for at least 12 months
observations.measures: Estimated long-term moves out of the UK.
observations.does_not_measure: Only enforced or voluntary immigration returns.

observations.title: Non-visit visa grants
observations.population: Entry clearance grants for non-visit reasons
observations.measures: Permissions issued under non-visit entry routes.
observations.does_not_measure: Unique arrivals, net migration or in-country extensions.

observations.title: Passenger arrivals
observations.population: Passengers arriving in the UK, including British nationals and repeat travellers

observations.title: People claiming asylum
observations.measures: People included in asylum claims raised during the period.
observations.does_not_measure: Cases alone, decisions or people arriving during that period.

observations.title: People receiving initial decisions
observations.population: Main applicants and dependants receiving initial decisions
observations.measures: People covered by initial decisions issued in the period.
observations.does_not_measure: Only claims lodged in the same period or final appeal outcomes.

observations.title: People granted protection or other leave
observations.population: Main applicants and dependants granted protection or other leave at initial decision
observations.measures: People receiving an initial grant following an asylum claim.
observations.does_not_measure: All eventual grants after appeals or a claim-cohort success rate.

observations.title: Initial asylum grant rate
observations.population: Main applicants with substantive initial decisions
observations.measures: Share of initial decisions granting protection or other leave.
observations.does_not_measure: Dependants, withdrawals, administrative outcomes or eventual success after appeal.
observations.denominator: Initial grants plus refusals, main applicants only

observations.title: People receiving asylum support
observations.population: People receiving Home Office asylum support
observations.measures: People supported at the reference date.
observations.does_not_measure: Annual arrivals, all asylum claimants or the initial-decision backlog.

observations.title: People in hotel accommodation
observations.population: Supported asylum seekers in hotel accommodation across the UK
observations.measures: National supported population in hotels on the reference date.
observations.does_not_measure: Hotel count, capacity, addresses or locations.

observations.title: Work visa grants
observations.population: Main applicants and dependants on work entry clearance routes
observations.does_not_measure: Jobs filled, workers employed or in-country extensions.

observations.title: Settlement grants
observations.population: Recipients of settlement grants outside the separately reported EUSS series
observations.measures: Grants of indefinite leave within the settlement series.
observations.does_not_measure: New arrivals, citizenship or EUSS settled-status grants.

observations.title: Enforced and voluntary returns
observations.population: People recorded in enforced and voluntary return categories
observations.measures: Recorded returns in these two categories.
observations.does_not_measure: All emigration, port returns or a count of asylum refusals.

observations.title: Estimated accommodation contract cost
observations.locator: Summary paragraph 4; correction slip dated 1 July 2025
observations.population: Asylum Accommodation and Support Contracts (AASCs), UK regional contracts
observations.measures: Forecast total over the contract term, reported by the NAO in 2025.
observations.does_not_measure: Annual spend, money already paid or a current 2026 forecast.
